translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Dawid dwom a ɔtoeɛ ɛberɛ a ɔboa pa danee ɔbɔdamfoɔ wɔ Abimelek anim no na ɔpanin no gyaee no ma ɔkɔeɛ no akyi.

content.text: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade berɛ nyinaa;
nʼayɛyie wɔ mʼanom daa.
Me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu;
ma amanehunufoɔ nte na wɔn nni ahurisie.
Mo ne me nkamfo Awurade;
momma yɛmmɔ mu nkamfo ne din!
Mefrɛɛ Awurade na ɔgyee me so;
na ɔyii me firii mʼakomatuo nyinaa mu.
Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nʼanim no hyerɛn
na wɔn anim rengu ase da.
Ohiani yi frɛeɛ, na Awurade tiee no;
na ɔgyee no firii nʼahohia nyinaa mu.
Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ wɛn wɔn a wɔsuro no,
na ɔgye wɔn.
Monka nhwɛ na monhunu sɛ Awurade yɛ.
Nhyira ne onipa a ɔhinta wɔ ne mu.
Monsuro Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefoɔ,
na wɔn a wɔsuro noɔ no nhia hwee.
Agyata yɛ mmrɛ na ɛkɔm de wɔn,
nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, adepa biara remmɔ wɔn.
Mommra, me mma, monyɛ aso mma me;
mɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo Awurade ho suro.
Mo mu hwan na ɔpɛ nkwa
na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhunu nna papa bebree?
Ɛnneɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔka kasa bɔne, na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔgyae atorɔtwa.
Twe wo ho firi bɔne ho, na yɛ papa;
hwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ na ti no.
Awurade ani wɔ ateneneefoɔ so
na ɔtie wɔn mpaeɛbɔ;
Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne,
sɛ ɔbɛyi wɔn nkaeɛ afiri asase yi so.
Ateneneefoɔ team su, na Awurade tie wɔn;
ɔyi wɔn firi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.
Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔapa aba
na ɔgye wɔn a wɔadwerɛ wɔn wɔ honhom mu no nkwa.
Onipa tenenee bɛhunu amaneɛ bebree
nanso Awurade gye no firi ne nyinaa mu;
ɔbɔ ne nnompe nyinaa ho ban,
sɛdeɛ emu baako mpo mmu.
Bɔne bɛkum ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ;
ɔteneneeni atamfoɔ bɛnya afɔbuo.
Awurade gye nʼasomfoɔ nkwa;
wɔn a wɔdwane toa noɔ no mu biara renkɔ afɔbuo mu.
